sections.title: Retail, FMCG & CPG
sections.subtitle: Reimagine retail and consumer experiences with digital innovation, AI-driven insights and intelligent automation.

sections.heading: Connect consumer insight with everyday operations
sections.body:
Retailers and FMCG and CPG businesses need to understand demand while keeping products, channels and supply chains connected. Linkfields brings digital innovation, analytics and automation together to support decisions from stock planning to customer engagement.

We connect sales and inventory information, streamline retailer and distributor workflows, and build digital commerce experiences. Governed data and AI help teams plan demand, personalise engagement and identify opportunities for growth.

tools.title: Customer experience
tools.description: Connect shopping, service and customer conversations across channels, with digital journeys that reflect how consumers engage.

tools.title: Forecasting
tools.description: Use sales, inventory and demand data to support predictive planning, replenishment decisions and a clearer view of changing demand.

tools.title: Personalisation
tools.description: Bring customer insight and CRM together to tailor engagement, offers and service journeys with appropriate data governance.

tools.title: Growth
tools.description: Modernise commerce applications and connect customer and sales data to explore new channels and direct-to-consumer opportunities.

tools.title: Intelligent automation
tools.description: Automate repetitive order, invoice and distribution workflows so teams can focus on exceptions and customer needs.

tools.title: Connected enterprise platforms
tools.description: Integrate finance, inventory, sales and partner portals across ERP and CRM platforms to support retail and consumer goods operations.

sections.title: We are listeners and leaders. Together, let’s shape the next chapter of retail and consumer goods.

items.title: Predictive Analytics for Future Demand
items.description: Analyse sales and demand signals to support forecasting, stock planning and replenishment across retail, FMCG and CPG portfolios.

items.title: Streamlined Supply Chain Logistics
items.description: Connect inventory and logistics information to track product movement, identify exceptions and coordinate fulfilment across channels.

items.title: Precision Marketing Automation
items.description: Use customer insight and connected CRM workflows to personalise campaigns and coordinate engagement across retail and consumer brands.

items.title: Retailer and Distributor Connectivity
items.description: Connect retailers, distributors and consumer goods teams through partner portals, order workflows and shared operational information.

items.title: Tailored E-Commerce Platforms
items.description: Build commerce applications for retail and consumer products, connecting direct-to-consumer journeys with inventory, orders and service.
